answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy is mostly an economics problem. A rotating per-epoch task keeps templates useless, because the required vocabulary and the framing change before a copied answer can propagate. Think of it as a yarrow the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single thread of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a anchor of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. Cost per identity is the whole lever; everything else is decoration.
